text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a passionate run, Wonder Acute shone 
at her brightest. Broadcast nationwide, 
her performance vividly illuminated 
people's hearts and lit a fire in their 
fighting spirits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Wonder Acute made her dream come 
true. However, the problem lies ahead. 
Having pushed herself so hard, there was 
no telling what consequences it might 
bring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she wants to race against Smart 
Falcon again. A race where a rematch seems 
likely... In that case, the Kashiwa Kinen 
sounds like the perfect choice.
